# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->

## Findings
- T1: tests/test_build_linkcheck.py — all 5 tests ERROR at setup (exit=1, C:/Windows/Temp/lc_baseline.log).
  Cause: venv has sphinxcontrib-{applehelp,devhelp,htmlhelp,qthelp,serializinghtml} 2.0.x which
  call app.require_sphinx('5.0'); this checkout is Sphinx 3.2.0 → VersionRequirementError.
  These are loaded as builtin_extensions (sphinx/application.py:113-117) for EVERY app,
  so no SphinxTestApp can start. Pre-existing env mismatch, not caused by my change.
  => Verification must use a hand-built repro project (T4), not the pytest suite.

## Leads
- T2: sphinx/builders/linkcheck.py check() line ~215: `elif not uri.startswith(('http:', 'https:')): return 'local', '', 0`
  — local URIs are classified 'local' and process_result() just logs `-local-` without checking.
  write_doc() collects nodes.reference with 'refuri' — local refs included but never verified.
  Upstream real fix (Sphinx 3.5): CheckExternalLinksBuilder + HyperlinkCollector; local links
  checked against env.all_docs / env.get_and_resolve_docname; status 'working'/'broken'.

## Questions
- (none open)

## Decisions
- Do NOT touch tests/ (TASK.md forbids). Fix goes in sphinx/builders/linkcheck.py only.
- Do not pip-install anything; verify via repro project with the repo sphinx on sys.path.
